landing.heroSubtitle: Factories pay to cut carbon. Farmers get paid to grow it back.
landing.aboutText: CarbonKheti connects smallholder farmers in India with companies that want to fund climate-friendly farming. Farmers who change their practices — like stopping field burning or using less water — earn carbon credits. Companies buy these credits to reduce their climate impact. Every credit is verified and tracked.
landing.step2: A field agent records farming practices
landing.step3: Evidence is verified by our team
landing.step4: Carbon credits are issued to the farmer
landing.step5: Companies buy credits, farmers get paid
